نتدهور (form IIq)
# نَتَدَهْوَرُ (natadahwaru) /na.ta.dah.wa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَدَهْوَرَ (tadahwara)
# نَتَدَهْوَرَ (natadahwara) /na.ta.dah.wa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَدَهْوَرَ (tadahwara)
# نَتَدَهْوَرْ (natadahwar) /na.ta.dah.war/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَدَهْوَرَ (tadahwara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
